input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

messages.text: My own necklace and earrings were stolen together from my apartment on October 2. Their combined value is about $2,400. My declarations say $30,000 for belongings, so does that mean the theft limit for my jewelry is $30,000 too?
Are you asking for a payment estimate or which limit applies?
Only the applicable limit. I do not want a payout calculation, and neither item is scheduled.

personal_property_limit.description: Issued total personal-property limit in USD.

jewelry_theft_sublimit.description: Applicable per-occurrence jewelry-theft sublimit in USD.

sublimit_additional_to_property_limit.description: Whether the jewelry sublimit is an additional amount above the total personal-property limit.

payment_estimate.description: Payment estimate in USD, or null when not requested or not supported.
